    • Next Episode (11): Thursday, March 19, 2026
    • Platform: HBO Max
    • International: India (Friday, 7:30 a.m. IST), Australia (Friday, 1 p.m. AEDT) 
    The second season features a total of 15 episodes, running weekly through April 16.
